Klaviyo is absent from the full fetched main tree. At review (80d70a7ef72df094d624464fd5f33739f4b5b039) native 3.0.2 / stable revision 2026-07-15 / 238 paths / 345 operations. Native validation fails only on five font_family defaults that match more than one oneOf alternative; the exact recipe removes only those defaults. New revisions use new version directories.
sources.coverage: Klaviyo REST API, GA (stable) revision only: profiles, lists/segments, events, metrics, campaigns, flows, templates, forms, catalogs, reporting and related resources. Beta endpoints are excluded by the vendor's own stable/beta split. Preserve vendor revision header semantics, OAuth/API-key authentication and per-endpoint scopes. No curation is invented for this new provider.

sources.discovery: Official Jira Cloud platform REST v3 download linked from the Atlassian developer reference; the stored file's x-origin (developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/swagger-v3.v3.json) redirects to this canonical dac-static URL, as for Confluence. The vendor stamps info.version per build (1001.0.0-SNAPSHOT-<sha>), so the existing jira/1001.0.0-SNAPSHOT directory is refreshed in place (stable_directory). At review (2026-10-08) native 3.0.1 / 423 paths / 620 operations vs stored 327 paths. Native validation fails only on four empty-string array-item defaults outside their enums; the exact recipe removes only those. Hosted health not_assessed; no Git revision claimed.
sources.coverage: Jira Cloud platform REST API v3 (issues, projects, workflows, fields, screens, users, permissions and related platform resources), including vendor experimental/deprecated labels. Not Jira Software (agile), Service Management or Data Center APIs. Preserve tenant server, OAuth/basic authentication and scopes.

sources.discovery: Official netlify/open-api repository (public, unarchived; README: OpenAPI reference for the Netlify API behind its Go/JS clients; checked 2026-10-08), the exact swagger.yml already cited by the stored 2.16.0 Swagger. Native Swagger 2.0 / 2.60.0 / 117 paths at review (065567609ce5b47bd210876b86460c659d077d3c) vs stored 2.16.0 / 75 paths. Locked swagger2openapi 7.0.8 makes zero warnings and exactly three counted repairs, all traced to fixUpSubSchema translating the three x-nullable:true properties of databaseComputeSettingsRequest (min_cu, max_cu, sleep_timeout_seconds). Each is guarded; a control conversion without those extensions must have zero warnings/patches and otherwise identical output. Historical 2.16.0 Swagger is the initial curation baseline and stays byte-identical.
sources.coverage: Netlify REST API (sites, deploys, builds, forms, functions, DNS, environment variables, database compute and related resources) as published by the vendor. Preserve OAuth authentication and vendor notes; not every Netlify product (e.g. Netlify Functions runtime APIs).

schema.description: Minimum compute units (0.25 to 16.0). Must be less than or equal to max_cu.
Maximum compute units (0.25 to 16.0). Must be greater than or equal to min_cu. max_cu - min_cu must not exceed 8.0.
Seconds of inactivity before the compute endpoint is suspended. Use -1 for always on, or a non-negative value.

sources.discovery: Official Bitbucket Cloud REST API Swagger description served by api.bitbucket.org (the stored file's x-origin bitbucket.org/api/swagger.json points to the same publication). Fixed declared version 2.0 is refreshed in place. Native Swagger 2.0 / 171 paths at review (2026-10-08). Locked swagger2openapi 7.0.8 makes zero warnings and one counted converter step, traced to processResponse visiting the already-empty description of DELETE /repositories/{workspace}/{repo_slug}/branch-restrictions/{id} 204; the empty string is left unchanged, the same reviewed class as Mailchimp Marketing's counts. Hosted health not_assessed; no Git revision claimed.
sources.coverage: Bitbucket Cloud REST API 2.0 (repositories, pull requests, pipelines, workspaces, issues, branch restrictions and related resources). Preserve OAuth/basic/API-token authentication and vendor deprecation notes; not Bitbucket Data Center.
sources.import_blocker: In-place refresh of fixed 2.0 would remove 28 paths / 47 operations. The vendor changelog evidences 25 (Issue Tracker removal announced 2026-08-20; Connect addon linker removal); five cross-workspace routes (/workspaces, /repositories, /user/permissions/repositories, /user/permissions/workspaces, /pullrequests/{selected_user}) lack vendor evidence (checked 2026-10-08). Review before importing.
